description: This file defines the main application component for a React-based frontend. It includes a custom hook to detect viewport size and conditionally renders an overlay to restrict access to desktop devices only, along with importing routing components.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects if the current viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px). It listens to window resize events and updates reactively.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React functional component that renders an overlay message indicating the application is only accessible on desktop devices.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that conditionally renders either the desktop-only overlay or the application's routes based on viewport size.
